articles.title: Delhi HC quashes look-out circular against NDTV founders Prannoy, Radhika Roy

articles.title: Palantir CTO says artificial intelligence is key to reshoring American manufacturing
articles.summary: Palantir's CTO, Shyam Sankar, asserts in his book "Mobilize" that artificial intelligence is crucial for reshoring American manufacturing.
